STAND.hold_condition: stable upright double support under zero velocity command
STAND.exit_condition: a supported outgoing transition is planned and its entry preconditions pass
STAND.failure_condition: fall, torso contact, flight, dangerous support loss, or sustained saturation

WALK.entry_condition: incoming transition completion contract satisfied and WALK expert acceptance gate passes
WALK.hold_condition: sustained walking, speed/heading tracking, stable contacts, bounded slip/flight/saturation
WALK.exit_condition: a supported outgoing transition is planned and its entry preconditions pass
WALK.failure_condition: fall, tracking loss, path drift, dangerous slip/flight, or long-dwell saturation

RUN.entry_condition: incoming transition completion contract satisfied and RUN expert acceptance gate passes
RUN.hold_condition: formal RUN steady-state contract to be defined in Stage 6
RUN.exit_condition: a supported outgoing transition is planned
RUN.failure_condition: formal RUN failure contract to be defined in Stage 6

CROUCH_HOLD.entry_condition: STAND_TO_CROUCH completion and stable crouch acceptance
CROUCH_HOLD.hold_condition: bounded posture depth with stable support
CROUCH_HOLD.exit_condition: CROUCH_TO_STAND is planned and entry preconditions pass
CROUCH_HOLD.failure_condition: fall, support loss, posture error, or saturation
